map.转化率计算器根据访问量与转化动作数计算转化率，并估算转化成本，帮助评估营销活动效: The conversion rate calculator computes conversion rate from visits and conversions and estimates cost per conversion, helping evaluate campaign performance and delivery ROI, for operations and growth teams.
map.活动后算每单转化成本 CPA 与整体 ROI。: After a campaign, compute cost per order (CPA) and overall ROI.
map.对比不同渠道 CPA 决定预算倾斜。: Compare CPA across channels to decide where to shift budget.
map.给定客单价反推转化带来的利润。: Back-calculate the profit from a conversion given the order value.
map.：总花费 5000、转化 100、客单价 200 → CPA=50 元；收入=1: : total spend 5,000, 100 conversions, order value 200 -> CPA = 50 CNY; revenue = 100 x 200 = 20,000, profit = 20,000 - 5,000 = 15,000, ROI = 15000/5000 = 300%.
map.：渠道 A CPA=40、渠道 B CPA=80，同样客单价下 A 利润更高，预: : channel A CPA = 40, channel B CPA = 80; at the same order value A earns more profit, so give budget to A first until marginal CPAs even out.
map.CPC 是单次点击价，CPA 是单次转化（成交/留资）价，CPA 更贴近业务结果: CPC is the price per click, CPA the price per conversion (sale or lead); CPA is closer to the business outcome.
map.负 ROI 说明获客不划算，先降 CPA（优化落地页/定向）或提客单价，而非加预: Negative ROI means acquisition does not pay; first cut CPA (optimize landing pages and targeting) or raise order value rather than adding budget.
